thread:
maya: Heads-up — prepping a customer pipeline story with KineticHealth next month. Want benchmark chart + short webinar panel. Timeline: publish post 2024-08-10, webinar 2024-08-14. Need interview, quote approval/legal sign-off, and a 2-min highlight video. @alex can you own recording?

alex: Yep, I can. I'll coordinate with the customer for a 30-min interview. What assets do we need from them?

maya: Short checklist: 1) consent form signed 2) quote text 3) performance numbers + permitted metrics 4) logo + headshots 5) 2–3 bullet use-cases. I'll DM the customer intro.

sara: I'll start the draft post and hero chart. Can you drop the raw metrics (CSV)? Prefer 99th pct latency and cost per 1k tokens if available.

alex: Customer DM'd the CSV and allowed sharing. Uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/workspace/kinetic/benchmarks — access set to marketing-view.

natalie_legal: Looping in legal. Two quick notes — we need explicit written permission for the quote and webinar appearance. Please send the proposed quote text and a redlineable doc. Our consent template: https://legal.redwood/consent-template.pdf

maya: Draft quote suggestion: "KineticHealth saw 6x throughput and reduced inference spend by 41%" — OK to present like that, @natalie_legal?

natalie_legal: Need provenance for both numbers. Add parenthetical with time period/test conditions (e.g., "in our internal 2-week benchmark vs baseline X"). Better: get the customer to approve exact phrasing. Also we need a signed consent form for the webinar clip. I'll draft an approval email template.

alex: Customer prefers a single doc with 2 phrasing options. I'll send both and request sign-off today.

calendar-bot: Scheduled: "KineticHealth interview — 30m" with Alex + Kinetic contact on 2024-07-31 15:00 PT. Join: https://meet.redwood/abc-123

sara: Quick Q — should the benchmark chart show absolute tokens/sec or normalized per GPU? I can produce both but would like direction.

maya: Include both. Use normalized per V100-equivalent and raw tokens/sec. Sara, tag me on the first draft and I'll do the messaging pass.

alex: After the interview I'll export a 2-min highlight clip and drop it into #marketing-assets along with the transcript. I'll also note exact phrasing the customer approves.

natalie_legal: Once we have a signed consent and the customer-approved quote, please run the final copy by me before publishing. If they request redlines we can broker edits, but final approval must be explicit. :memo:

maya: :thumbsup: thanks all — sprinting on the draft this afternoon.
